{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''XY'' home video releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY|Pocket Monsters XY]]'' of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ==Volume releases== ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY|Pocket Monsters XY]]'' was divided into two sets that were released by [[Shogakukan]] from 2014 to 2017. It contains all the [[List of Pokémon the Series: XY episodes|146 episodes]] between them. ===Pocket Monsters XY=== Pocket Monsters XY was released by [[Shogakukan]] from 2014 to 2016. It consists of 32 volumes with 96 episodes across them combined.
